desc:
🏈 Draw your own routes on the chalkboard and beat your defender
🎯 Be the QB: aim, time and throw every pass yourself
🏆 Play 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3. First to 4 wins!
⚡ Unlock releases from Common to Divine to beat the jam
🎉 Celebrate touchdowns with emotes from Emote Boxes
🔥 Stack wins, build your streak and climb the leaderboard
👬 Party up with friends and queue together

❗Latest Update❗
• NEW 2v2 & 3v3 TEAM MODES
• NEW QB SYSTEM: aim your throws, control the arc
• PARTIES: invite friends & queue as a team
• Bigger fields for team games
• EMOTE BOXES + touchdown celebrations
• NEW DIVINE RELEASES: Bull & Phantom
• Rare one-handed catches 👀
• Win streaks & records over your head

❗ Stay updated by clicking FOLLOW! On phone or tablet? Tap the 🔔!
🔔 Join the group for updates on the game!
💰 Grab the 2x Coins pass to earn double coins every match!
